name: clipzyme_reactzyme_reaction_similarity_baseline_contract_v1

authoritative_external_baseline.name: CLIPZyme
authoritative_external_baseline.paper: CLIPZyme: Reaction-Conditioned Virtual Screening of Enzymes
authoritative_external_baseline.execution_rule: The formal baseline is the released CLIPZyme model and native author encoders. Replacing its reaction encoder with MAT, UniMol, RDKit, ReactZyme or Catalyst features creates a separate ablation/reproduction and is never the authoritative CLIPZyme direct-delta baseline.

tiger_reference.name: TIGER
tiger_reference.reason_not_selected: No official executable implementation or clean independent reproduction is available as of 2026-09-01.
tiger_reference.methodology_allowed: Its split framing, bidirectional evaluation and clearly-labeled CLIPZyme ablations may inform methodology, but TIGER paper numbers and encoder-substitution variants may not replace the executable CLIPZyme baseline.

official_reactzyme_split.input_semantics_boundary: reaction_smi supplies unordered dot-separated molecule bags and does not itself provide substrate>>product direction. The official CLIPZyme reaction encoder requires a directed atom-mapped reaction with aligned reactant/product atom-map sets. Therefore the full ReactZyme reaction_smi matrix is not automatically a valid native CLIPZyme input domain.

baseline_native_inputs.reaction_encoder: official CLIPZyme aligned difference-graph/pseudo-transition reaction encoder via extract_reaction_features
baseline_native_inputs.required_reaction_semantics: directed substrate>>product reaction with author-compatible atom mapping; direction may not be guessed from molecule order or target labels
baseline_native_inputs.protein_encoder: author CLIPZyme protein embedding, preferably released clipzyme_screening_set.p; otherwise only the official CLIPZyme protein inference implementation/checkpoint and its required inputs

reactzyme_compatibility_audit.allowed_direction_recovery: Only an independently provenance-traceable mapping from a ReactZyme reaction identity to an actual directed reaction record may be used. Mapping must not depend on Catalyst scores, test labels, ranking outcomes or arbitrary molecule ordering.
forbidden_direction_recovery: splitting the unordered molecule bag by position
choosing a direction that maximizes CLIPZyme or Catalyst performance
using target labels or retrieved enzymes to infer direction
training a replacement reaction encoder and calling it CLIPZyme
reactzyme_compatibility_audit.reaction_requirement_after_recovery: official CLIPZyme graph prerequisite after deterministic mapping: all atoms positively/uniquely mapped and reactant/product map sets identical
reactzyme_compatibility_audit.protein_requirement: exact author screening-registry identifier or author-native protein inference support
reactzyme_compatibility_audit.pair_support: intersection of the two author-input domains only
reactzyme_compatibility_audit.decision_rule: If at least 50 reaction queries have independently recoverable directed author-compatible inputs, freeze that exact subset before any scores and run both CLIPZyme and Catalyst on the same subset. If fewer than 50 remain, do not modify CLIPZyme; mark this ReactZyme direct comparison unsupported and move the formal reaction-novel comparison to a separately frozen directed-reaction benchmark.

metrics.query_semantics: Report R2E and E2R separately on the exact common score matrix. Hit@K is any-positive-in-top-K; MRR is standard best-positive reciprocal rank unless an explicitly separate author-paper metric is named.

benchmark_reveal_state.role: descriptive authoritative-baseline alignment plus coverage/capability evidence only

allowed_adaptation: provenance-traceable recovery of true reaction direction from an independent reaction record
RXNMapper atom mapping solely after true direction is known and solely to satisfy CLIPZyme native input
forbidden_adaptation: MAT/UniMol/RDKit/ReactZyme reaction encoder substituted into the formal CLIPZyme baseline

secondary_methodology_ablation.name: TIGER-inspired CLIP-style MAT-2D+ESM ReactZyme-protocol reproduction
secondary_methodology_ablation.role: methodology/ablation only; may be useful for understanding the ReactZyme molecule-bag setting but must never be labeled as the official CLIPZyme checkpoint result

asset_acquisition.status: preferred for author-precomputed protein support; direct Zenodo access from nju-server-06 returned HTTP 403 in the current audit, so acquisition must remain provenance-preserving and checksum-verified

next_actions: Acquire or recover the official CLIPZyme screening protein asset without changing the baseline implementation.
Run the performance-blind ReactZyme reaction-direction compatibility audit using only independent reaction provenance.

If the native common subset is large enough, freeze it and score official CLIPZyme once; otherwise freeze a separate directed reaction-novel benchmark and adapt Catalyst upward to that unchanged CLIPZyme support.
Do not resume the rejected E2R Rescue V2 family on its used development split.
